newsitem.title: UK: Merrill adds 50 mln marks to Euro-certificates.
newsitem.headline: Merrill adds 50 mln marks to Euro-certificates.

text.p: Merrill Lynch International & Co CV, Curacao has increased its German Top Twelve Euro-Certificates to 200 million marks from 150 million marks, lead manager Merrill Lynch Deutschland said.
Maturing in November 2000, redemption will be linked to German Top Twelve Total Return Index. There is an investor put right on November 6, 1998 and November 5, 1999.
The pay date of the increase is January 21, 1997. The issue price is 1125.90 marks. Fees are 2.30 percent split 0.30 percent management and underwriting and 2.0 percent selling.
The issue is guaranteed by Merrill Lynch and Co, rated AA- by Standard and Poors and AA3 by Moody's.

Demoninations of 1000 marks, the issue will be listed in Luxembourg and Frankfurt. Governing law is German and there are U.S. sales limits. There is force majeure and negative pledge but no cross default.
